hypothesis: A full cut image can expose jointly forbidden leaf patterns missed by binary care, yielding new positive non-combinational Build recipes after the fixed scorr plus matched COM prefix.
single_algorithm_variable: Replace pairwise care projection by full cut-pattern projection; retain the same at-most-six-leaf, at-most-eight-cuts-per-root enumeration, greedy two-polarity SOP completion, positive conservative MFFC filter, free-state SAT check, and one-recipe-per-root ranking.
proof_rule: A cut assignment is forbidden only if its assumptions are UNSAT in both the reset image and the free-prestate one-step image of the original AIG. SAT or UNKNOWN in either image leaves it allowed. Sampled signatures guide which assignments to query but cannot prove a forbidden assignment.

comparison.valid_only_if: Original ABC-loaded AIG and final product have a matching typed interface; DSEC PASS; each counted Build has a replayed free-state SAT witness, complete SEQ certificate, and positive exact selected-set cleanup contribution.
comparison.primary_metric: For each paired valid case, exact non-combinational SEQ Build AND gain divided by that case's original ABC-loaded AND; report arithmetic mean across cases, as well as total AND and count.
comparison.missing_policy: Keep every timeout, undecided, assertion, parser failure, and unavailable prefix as a separate outcome; never impute zero reduction or include in a paired mean.
robustness: independent HWMCC eligible cohort with typed checker

stage_gates: First run a uniform-budget offline opportunity screen over the complete fixed cohort; report all cases and costs.
Only if multiple independent cases show new positive free-SAT recipes, construct an isolated C import variant and run the paired ABC matrix.
Do not claim Guide success from recipe potential, a single case, total final AND, or a common-completed subset without its failures and leave-one-out analysis.
